observations: VoiceInputPacket already carries vad_state, endpoint_decision, overlap_state and a boolean barge_in classification into VoicePacketCortex.
VoicePacketCortex.accept_input treats barge_in=true as an already-made interruption decision and immediately propagates cancellation before recording the input packet.
Existing packet-cortex tests prove cancellation, heard_fraction preservation, stale-tool rejection and explicit WAIT/BACKCHANNEL intent representation.
The mapped packet-cortex tests do not establish the upstream rule that distinguishes a short user backchannel from a real floor bid before barge_in is set.

The mapped packet-cortex surface likewise does not establish self-output/echo rejection before barge_in or mid-sentence pause continuation classification; these may intentionally belong to an upstream producer rather than this cortex class.

No dedicated turn/floor classifier was identified in the mapped src/frankenstein2 voice-file surface, but this source-only mapping is insufficient to claim global absence because a producer may live in another adapter/tool/runtime path.
counterhypothesis: A current producer outside the mapped voice_packet_cortex source/test surface already classifies short backchannels, real floor bids, self-output/echo and pause continuation correctly before constructing VoiceInputPacket; if found with executable fixtures, this candidate is falsified and no new classifier component is needed.

discriminator.name: T7_BARGE_IN_INGRESS_CLASSIFICATION_MATRIX_V1
steps: Locate every non-test producer/constructor/adaptor that creates VoiceInputPacket or sets the barge_in field in the current release/runtime path.
Bind the exact current producer subject before mutation.
Exercise short German backchannel while output is active and require retain-floor/barge_in=false unless explicit floor-bid evidence is present.
Exercise sustained German interruption/floor bid while output is active and require barge_in=true with one cancellation causal boundary.
Exercise self-output/echo-like ingress during agent speech and require rejection or barge_in=false; no recursive self-interruption.
Exercise mid-sentence pause followed by continuation and require HOLD/continue-listen rather than premature endpoint/VoiceOutcome.
Exercise overlap then user withdrawal and require recovery without duplicate output, stale tool ownership or duplicate state write.
discriminator.classification_rule: If an admitted producer passes all cases, close this candidate as FALSIFIED_NO_NEW_COMPONENT. If no producer owns the classification boundary, route the smallest integration blocker through Trigger4. If a producer executes and violates a case, classify PRODUCT_NEGATIVE at that exact producer scope before repair.

next_exact_action: Resolve the current RBOUND1-RBOUND5 recovery discriminator first where it is the active higher-priority executable frontier, then perform the non-mutating producer-location pass for T7_BARGE_IN_INGRESS_CLASSIFICATION_MATRIX_V1 and route only a demonstrated uncovered boundary to Trigger4.
